tasks.short: Prepare attendance, personnel, and agency reports.

steps.what: Prepare activity, planning, and accounting reports
Maintain attendance and personnel records
Direct preparation and maintenance activities
Confirm the pack for officials and agencies
Sign the report pack
Send the signed report pack
outputs: filed copy of signed report pack v1

tasks.design: A dashboard in {BI} prepares activity, planning, and accounting reports from posted rows. The administrator maintains attendance and personnel records, directs the preparation, and confirms the pack for officials and agencies. They sign it. A job sends that version. A figure with no posted row is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: A report could leave with a number nobody had checked against the record.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted rows can feed a report without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: What officials should be told is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator signs the pack and remains responsible for it.

ambition.what: Refresh the tables when the period closes, and send only a newly signed pack.

tasks.altitude: The review stays. Copying posted rows shrinks.

evidence.claim: The manager digest says a report can be built from the records, and any commentary must be checked against those figures.
Digest [S15] records that a model-drafted review cited sources that did not exist and a court case that was fabricated, so every cited clause or figure must match a source row.

assumptions: Configure the records before a new store.
unknowns: How attendance is defined for a part day.
research_questions: How often a posted row is corrected after the table is built.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the records step is maintenance the person still does.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every figure is still checked against a posted row. The high end assumes only the table build is no longer done by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret government codes and develop safety procedures.

steps.what: Review government codes already stored
Develop procedures from each stored code

loop.purpose: Propose a procedure sentence only from a stored government code.
loop.input: The stored code text and the administrator's outline.
loop.output: A procedure draft that cites the clause id.
loop.check: Every clause id in the draft is present in the stored code.
loop.stop: Stop when a sentence has no clause id, or when the outline does not cover that code.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell which clause applies to this facility.

steps.what: Interpret government codes for facility safety
Ensure security and maintenance duties are named
Sign the facility procedure
File the signed facility procedure
outputs: filed copy of signed facility procedure v1

tasks.design: The administrator reviews the government codes stored in {DOCS}. A bounded draft proposes procedures only from those clauses and the administrator's outline. The administrator interprets them for facility safety, security, and maintenance, signs the procedure, and a job files that version. A sentence with no clause id is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: A procedure could cite a code nobody had opened.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored codes can be quoted into a draft without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: What the facility must actually do is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator interprets the code and signs the procedure.

ambition.what: Re-read a procedure when a stored code changes, and sign it again.

tasks.altitude: The interpretation stays. Hunting the clause id shrinks.

evidence.claim: The manager digest says a model may summarise a stored rule and propose affected procedures, and the owner decides.
Digest [S15] records that a model-drafted review cited sources that did not exist and a court case that was fabricated, so every cited clause or figure must match a source row.

assumptions: The draft is not the procedure.
unknowns: Which codes apply to this building.
Who else must approve a safety duty.
research_questions: How often the stored code is behind the official text.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the review is the reading itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every cited clause is still opened by the administrator. The high end assumes only unmatched sentences are returned. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set educational standards, goals, policies, and programs.

steps.what: Set educational standards and goals
Establish policies, procedures, and programs
Sign the standards and the programs
File the signed standards
outputs: filed copy of signed standards v1

tasks.design: Setting educational standards and goals, and establishing policies, procedures, and programs, stays with the administrator. A job files the signed text in {DOCS}. No model writes the standard.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated policy could become the standard without the administrator having set it.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed text can be filed in the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: What the centre should stand for is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator sets the standard and signs it.
tasks.altitude: The standard stays with the administrator. Filing the signed text shrinks.

reach.task: Carry out only the signed standard

evidence.claim: The manager digest says curriculum, people, and marketing stay manual, with drafting help only.

assumptions: The job does not draft the standard.
unknowns: Which goals the authority already sets.
research_questions: How often a goal conflicts with a stored code.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on setting standards is the decision itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the standard is still written by the administrator. The high end assumes only the signed copy is no longer retyped. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare budget requests and grant proposals for funding.

steps.what: Total the posted budget for the program
Prepare budget requests from those totals
Draft grant proposals that cite the posted rows

loop.purpose: Draft grant prose that uses only figures from the posted budget rows.
loop.input: The administrator's outline and the posted budget rows.
loop.output: A proposal draft in which every number cites a row id.
loop.check: Every number in the draft matches a posted budget row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number has no row id, or when the outline does not ask for that figure.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot tell which posted figure the proposal is allowed to use.

steps.what: Decide how to solicit program funding
Sign the budget request and grant proposal
Submit the signed funding pack
outputs: filed copy of signed funding pack v1

tasks.design: A job totals the posted program budget in {ERP}. The administrator prepares the budget request. A bounded draft writes grant proposals only from that outline and those rows. The administrator decides how to solicit funding, signs the pack, and a job submits that version. A number with no row is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: A proposal could carry a figure that was never in the budget.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted budget rows can be totalled and cited without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Whether to ask for the funding, and how, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator signs the request and remains responsible for it.

ambition.what: Submit a funding pack in the same window, and only after a new signature.

tasks.altitude: The ask stays. Retyping posted figures shrinks.

reach.learn: Which budget row a figure came from

evidence.claim: The manager digest says a report can be built from the records, and any commentary must be checked against those figures.
Digest [S15] records that a model-drafted review cited sources that did not exist and a court case that was fabricated, so every cited clause or figure must match a source row.

assumptions: The draft is not the proposal.
unknowns: Who else must sign a grant.
research_questions: How often the posted budget changes before submission.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the request is the preparation the person still does.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every figure is still checked against a posted row. The high end assumes only a number with no row comes back. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The childcare administrator spends the week with children, parents, and staff. Tables and filing a signed note move to a job. No model hires, evaluates, or scores a child or a staff member.
reach: Parents hear about a child from the administrator, not from a generated note.
Teachers receive only the schedule or the action the administrator signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a headcount from a decision to hire or to change a program.
Reject a draft sentence that cites a code or a figure with no source row.
role.ambitious_version: A signed purchase or funding pack can go out the same week, and the administrator still authorizes it.
